 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The San Francisco 49ers will be without their top two wideouts against the Atlanta Falcons this weekend.
 Mike Evans (Achilles) and Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) have both been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons . Neither player participated in practice all week.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Wide receiver Christian Kirk is also questionable with a calf injury, but has been a full participant in practice after missing the start of the season. Niners head coach Kyle Shanahan said Friday Kirk was trending toward making his season debut :
 "Yeah," Shanahan responded. "Hopefully, tomorrow goes well, but we didn't do anything yesterday, so it was hard to really judge guys. But today we just finished a full-speed practice, and I haven't watched the film yet, but he looked good out there.
 "Talking to him, he felt good, and I think he felt good last week, so it's trending in the right direction right now."
 San Francisco signed Kirk as a free agent in the offseason but he has yet to play this season while recovering from the calf injury suffered during training camp.
 With Evans and Samuel out, and Demarcus Robinson and De'Zhaun Stribling still on IR, the 49ers receiver with the most yards this season among players suiting up Sunday will be Jordan Watkins, with 82.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Evans, playing in the first year of a three-year, $42.5 million deal , has been a bright spot for the team so far this season, leading them with 420 receiving yards plus three touchdowns in six games. He exited last week's game against the Commanders early and did not return.
 That Achilles injury was already a concern going into that week, with Evans questionable for the game, but Shanahan described the issue as "soreness" and didn't believe it required further testing .
 Samuel, meanwhile, has been out with the hamstring injury since Week 5. Both wideouts will have a bye week to recover following the Falcons game.
